mapper.select: SELECT 'PLAN' AS bizType, c.id AS ref, NULL AS occurredAt, c.gmt_created AS createdAt, NULL AS groupId, NULL AS sub, t.title AS label, NULL AS metricValue FROM care_plan_task_checkin c LEFT JOIN care_plan_task t ON t.id = c.task_id WHERE c.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND c.people_id = #{peopleId} AND c.checkin_date = #{day} AND c.status = 'DONE' AND c.recorded_by_people_id IS NOT NULL AND c.recorded_by_staff_id IS NULL AND c.is_deleted = 0 UNION ALL SELECT 'MED', i.id, NULL, i.gmt_created, NULL, NULL, m.drug_name, NULL FROM people_medication_intake i LEFT JOIN people_medication m ON m.id = i.medication_id WHERE i.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND i.people_id = #{peopleId} AND i.intake_date = #{day} AND i.status = 'TAKEN' AND i.time_slot <> 'PRN' AND i.recorded_by_staff_id IS NULL AND i.is_deleted = 0 UNION ALL SELECT 'VITAL', v.id, v.recorded_at, v.gmt_created, v.group_id, v.metric_type, NULL, v.value FROM vital_record v WHERE v.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND v.people_id = #{peopleId} AND v.recorded_at >= #{day} AND v.recorded_at < DATE_ADD(#{day}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND v.source <> 'STAFF' AND v.recorded_by_staff_id IS NULL AND v.is_deleted = 0 UNION ALL SELECT 'DIET', d.id, NULL, d.gmt_created, NULL, d.meal_type, CASE d.meal_type WHEN 'BREAKFAST' THEN '早餐' WHEN 'LUNCH' THEN '午餐' WHEN 'DINNER' THEN '晚餐' ELSE '加餐' END, NULL FROM diet_meal d WHERE d.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND d.people_id = #{peopleId} AND d.meal_date = #{day} AND d.source <> 'STAFF' AND d.recorded_by_staff_id IS NULL AND d.is_deleted = 0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM diet_meal_item it WHERE it.meal_id = d.id AND it.is_deleted = 0) UNION ALL SELECT 'EXERCISE', e.id, NULL, e.gmt_created, NULL, NULL, e.type_name, NULL FROM exercise_session e WHERE e.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND e.people_id = #{peopleId} AND e.exercise_date = #{day} AND e.source <> 'STAFF' AND e.recorded_by_staff_id IS NULL AND e.is_deleted = 0 UNION ALL SELECT 'REPORT_READ', r.id, NULL, r.patient_read_at, NULL, NULL, r.title, NULL FROM health_report r WHERE r.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND r.people_id = #{peopleId} AND r.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND r.patient_read_at >= #{day} AND r.patient_read_at < DATE_ADD(#{day}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND r.is_deleted = 0

SELECT DISTINCT d FROM ( SELECT checkin_date AS d FROM care_plan_task_checkin WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND people_id = #{peopleId} AND checkin_date BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} AND status = 'DONE' AND recorded_by_people_id IS NOT NULL AND recorded_by_staff_id IS NULL AND is_deleted = 0 UNION SELECT intake_date FROM people_medication_intake WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND people_id = #{peopleId} AND intake_date BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} AND status = 'TAKEN' AND time_slot <> 'PRN' AND recorded_by_staff_id IS NULL AND is_deleted = 0 UNION SELECT DATE(recorded_at) FROM vital_record WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND people_id = #{peopleId} AND recorded_at >= #{from} AND recorded_at < DATE_ADD(#{to}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND source <> 'STAFF' AND recorded_by_staff_id IS NULL AND is_deleted = 0 ) x ORDER BY d DESC

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(group_id, DATE_FORMAT(recorded_at, '%Y%m%d%H%i'))) FROM vital_record WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND people_id = #{peopleId} AND source <> 'STAFF' AND recorded_by_staff_id IS NULL AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM diet_meal WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND people_id = #{peopleId} AND source = 'PHOTO_AI' AND recorded_by_staff_id IS NULL AND is_deleted = 0

SELECT people_id AS peopleId, d AS day, SUM(n) AS actions FROM ( SELECT people_id, checkin_date AS d, COUNT(1) AS n FROM care_plan_task_checkin WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND checkin_date >= #{from} AND status = 'DONE' AND recorded_by_people_id IS NOT NULL AND recorded_by_staff_id IS NULL AND is_deleted = 0
GROUP BY people_id, checkin_date UNION ALL SELECT people_id, intake_date, COUNT(1) FROM people_medication_intake WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND intake_date >= #{from} AND status = 'TAKEN' AND time_slot <> 'PRN' AND recorded_by_staff_id IS NULL AND is_deleted = 0
GROUP BY people_id, intake_date UNION ALL SELECT people_id, DATE(recorded_at), COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(group_id, DATE_FORMAT(recorded_at, '%Y%m%d%H%i'))) FROM vital_record WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND recorded_at >= #{from} AND source <> 'STAFF' AND recorded_by_staff_id IS NULL AND is_deleted = 0
GROUP BY people_id, DATE(recorded_at) ) x GROUP BY people_id, d

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ( SELECT id FROM care_plan_task_checkin WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND people_id = #{peopleId} AND checkin_date >= #{from} AND DATE(gmt_created) > checkin_date AND status = 'DONE' AND recorded_by_people_id IS NOT NULL AND recorded_by_staff_id IS NULL AND is_deleted = 0 UNION ALL SELECT id FROM people_medication_intake WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND people_id = #{peopleId} AND intake_date >= #{from} AND DATE(gmt_created) > intake_date AND status = 'TAKEN' AND time_slot <> 'PRN' AND recorded_by_staff_id IS NULL AND is_deleted = 0 UNION ALL SELECT MIN(id) FROM vital_record WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND people_id = #{peopleId} AND recorded_at >= #{from} AND gmt_created > DATE_ADD(recorded_at, INTERVAL 12 HOUR) AND source <> 'STAFF' AND recorded_by_staff_id IS NULL AND is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY COALESCE(group_id, id) UNION ALL SELECT id FROM diet_meal WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND people_id = #{peopleId} AND meal_date >= #{from} AND DATE(gmt_created) > meal_date AND source <> 'STAFF' AND recorded_by_staff_id IS NULL AND is_deleted = 0 UNION ALL SELECT id FROM exercise_session WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND people_id = #{peopleId} AND exercise_date >= #{from} AND DATE(gmt_created) > exercise_date AND source <> 'STAFF' AND recorded_by_staff_id IS NULL AND is_deleted = 0 ) x
SELECT DISTINCT tenant_id AS tenantId, people_id AS peopleId FROM account_patient WHERE is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY tenant_id, people_id
